ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $User.Alias<> "sconn",
ISBLANK(BillingState),
OR( AND( $RecordType.Name = "SAP Germany", OR( BillingCountry = "United States", BillingCountry = "Canada", BillingCountry = "United Kingdom" ) ),
AND( OR( $RecordType.Name = "SAP Asia", $RecordType.Name = "S4 - Boulder", $RecordType.Name = "SAP NA Montreal", $RecordType.Name = "SAP NA Salem/MIA" ), OR( BillingCountry = "United States", BillingCountry = "Canada" ) ) ) )
